dependencies.name: archebase-vi-guide
dependencies.authority: brand facts, official assets, evidence, tokens, route playbooks and release gates
dependencies.resolution: Install or clone from the GitHub repository. A local filesystem checkout is a cache, not the canonical identity.
dependencies.update_policy: Do not float to main. Update tag/commit only after running upstream validators/evals and the visual-design regression suite.

non_goals: Do not copy the VI skill into this repository.
Do not vendor VI tokens, evidence, logos, validators or release gates.
Do not reconstruct brand facts from local PDFs, CSS, marketing material or memory.
